statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI requests A400FE/2 mapped extension tail and A600FE/2 inactive MP tail, not A600FA/6; checks masked F0FF == 0005, treats error 7 as no mapped extension, and Linux intentionally leaves A600FE mode activation to kernel. SDL exposes gyro for MP-only or MP+Nunchuk when probed, but its pinned Classic/Gamepad joystick-open path does not register an SDL gyro sensor. Report mode/status requests are conditional.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. SDL 3.2.10 driver 249-427,457-491,550-585,677-820,1540-1568; no Plus host tests. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
